style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent deep-space tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy-black gradient background from #0B1526 to #1B2A44, clean white rounded info cards #F4F6F8, pure white text #FFFFFF on dark panels and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D on white cards, and a single tech-blue accent #2D9CDB with subtle glow effects; cool temperature; modern geometric sans-serif headlines and labels; consistent white rounded info cards and thin-line blue gradient icons; dark studio product photography with controlled blue accent lighting mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for full lock views, tight macro for details, product always grounded with contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark panels and realistic dark wood entry door for scenes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, white headlines on dark panels and charcoal text on white cards, short labels only
